title: Northwind SaaS × Bluefin Travel: renewal call
attendees: Inês Duarte <ines@northwind.example>, Tom Okoro <tom@bluefintravel.example>, Lucía Ferrer <lucia@bluefintravel.example>
transcript:
Inês: The renewal is on the 1st of December. You're on forty seats today.
Tom: We'd like to go down to thirty-five. Five agents moved to the sales team.
Lucía: And if we sign for two years, we'd expect something like eight percent off.
Inês: I can't promise eight percent today. Anything above five percent needs approval on our side. Let me see what's possible.
Lucía: Understood. We also need your security questionnaire updated for our audit, by the 20th.
Inês: I'll send the updated security questionnaire by the 20th of November.
Inês: And I'll send a renewal quote for thirty-five seats with one-year and two-year options by Monday.
Tom: Great, that gives us time before the end of the month.
